name: Geek
description: Phosphor terminal with the discipline turned around: near-white type carries the prose so long sessions stay readable, while terminal green is demoted to the interaction layer — links, focus, indicators, buttons. Black is the unlit screen, green is the phosphor, white is the information.
author: Phaneris
